answer: Each identity bonds 60 credits at the wharf and trades walnut crates with 6 new counterparties each epoch. Each walnut crate crosses the wharf bridge, logged on the bridge ledger; overlap is public, and sharing over half burns the group bond. A first fake costs 210: 60 bond, 6 crates at 25 each; the k-th costs 210+12(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 6,204,000 plus 60,000 locked. Rented names recur; both sides are slashed. An honest agent pays once.
